scope: nonpaged coarse shape/Time with priority at native Time slice boundaries and workspace headroom
sourceNotes: First small-map pair includes shared shape-pipeline reuse; second adds strict weather-epoch visibility guards.

The final map4 pair and paged pair use the final source including headroom reclamation.
